goal: Implement a token-bucket rate limiter with explicit time, fractional refill, and retry hints.

steps.description: Implement TokenBucket::new (starts full), tokens, and refill (linear refill clamped at capacity, monotonic in time)
invariants: refill adds tokens_per_sec * elapsed, clamped at capacity
refill with an earlier timestamp is a no-op, not a panic

steps.description: Implement try_take: refill then take one token atomically, reporting remaining or a retry_in_secs hint
invariants: bursts up to capacity succeed; further takes are Denied with retry_in_secs = deficit / tokens_per_sec
waiting long enough refills and unblocks takes
